title: Optimal Gradient-Norm Minimization in Non-Euclidean Hölder-Smooth Convex Optimization
summary: Minimizing gradients of a convex function is an important problem across optimization and learning tasks. The gradient provides a directly computable certificate of approximate stationarity, and its minimization usually implies stronger results than those for minimization of function values. In this work, we study gradient-norm minimization for convex functions that are $(L,κ)$-Hölder smooth with respect to the $\ell_p$-norms, $p \geq 1$.
